new.analysis:
You did exactly what week one asked for: three even sessions, pain 0/10 each time, and the shin quiet the next morning. That earns a small progression, not a big one.

The step this week is in the running interval, not the number of sessions or the total distance. We move from short run bouts to 3 minutes of running with 1 minute of walking, which lifts your longest continuous run from about 2 minutes to 3. Total running time rises from roughly 45 to 50 minutes, which is the ceiling I want to stay under while the shin is still proving itself.

Keep every bout easy and conversational, and stop the run if the shin speaks up above a dull 2/10 or is sore the next morning. Four pain-free weeks in a row is what unlocks faster or longer work, so this week counts as week two of that streak only if the shin stays quiet. The physio calf and hip routine twice in the week is part of the plan, not a bonus.

safetyCallouts.title: Stop-rule for the shin.
safetyCallouts.body: If pain climbs above 2/10 during a run, or the shin is sorer the next morning, stop that session and message your physio before the next run.
